description: This file implements the CachedStreamBuffer class and related functionality for managing camera buffer streams, including buffer import/export, fence handling, and YUV data acquisition.

classes.name: ReleaseFence
classes.description: Manages a fence handle for synchronization, including creation and cleanup.

classes.name: CachedStreamBuffer
classes.description: Handles buffer management, including import/export, fences, and data access for camera stream buffers.

methods.name: CachedStreamBuffer::acquireAsYUV
methods.description: Locks the buffer as a YUV image and returns its layout.

methods.name: CachedStreamBuffer::acquireAsBlob
methods.description: Locks the buffer as a raw blob of specified size.
